summary.value: Sebulba carved out a well-deserved place in history as one of the galaxy's greatest racers. As canny as ever despite his advancing years, he's insisted on finding a role for himself in the Galactic League, unwilling to allow his legendary name to be forgotten.

description.value: The legendary Sebulba's Plug-F Mammoth is an icon as well as a brute, boasting a robust exterior designed to take down opponents while preserving its own integrity. That isn't to mention the removable systems built for bending former track regulations, such as flame vents.
Vehicle collisions result in lower received damage and higher given damage.
Afterburner tank refills at a reduced rate.

editorialNotes: Vehicle traits only, not Racer Style traits or selectable abilities. Mention of flame vents in vehicle prose does not prove an equipped Flame Vent ability. No numerical effect sizes are shown.
